news.headline: Central Florida Thu Nov 26 morning: NWS Melbourne River Flood Warning remains in effect, with a Rip Current Statement through Fri 1 AM, a Coastal Flood Advisory through Thu 11 AM and a Small Craft Advisory through Thu 7 PM — Melbourne at 7 AM mostly cloudy 61°F, wind W 15 mph gusting 25 mph, rain chance about 2%, Thu high 71°F / low 54°F

Builders outlook — Florida Trend Nov 23: NAHB chief economist Robert Dietz said building-material prices are up 10% from a year ago, with labor costs and mortgage rates of about 7% weighing on homebuilders in Jacksonville and beyond; he expects flat single-family trends next year but sees opportunity in remodeling and active-adult communities

Florida construction starts — McDowell Housing Partners closed $35.9 million in financing and began construction Nov 25 on Clara Landings, an 84-unit affordable housing development at 4470 Santa Barbara Blvd in Naples, financed with Florida Housing Finance Corporation tax-exempt bonds, 4% Low-Income Housing Tax Credits and $10 million in CDBG-DR funds; completion expected Spring 2028

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper bear market deepens Wed Nov 25 — ScrapMonster: LME copper fell 5.05% in Nov 24 trading to about $11,859 a metric ton, roughly 20% below its September peak near $14,900, while North American clean copper scrap grades fell 25 cents/lb on Nov 24 and China's Yangshan import premium eased to about $450/ton from a record near $500 — physical supply still tight despite lower futures

HVAC week in review Nov 25 — ACHR News data via HVAC Zone: heat pumps rose from about 28% of new homes in 2022 to nearly 48% in partial-year 2026 in a HERS dataset of more than 2.1 million rated homes, and AHRI put heat pumps at 44.7% of combined cooling equipment shipments in August 2026, up from 31% in August 2016; manufacturers posted higher third-quarter revenue, with data centers driving commercial demand and more price increases signaled

Inflation rose Wed Nov 25 — BEA: October PCE price index rose 0.3% in the month and 3.8% year over year, up from 3.6% in September, with core PCE up 3.3% year over year; personal income rose 0.7% and spending 0.3%, and markets priced a near-certain quarter-point Fed rate hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting from the current 3.75%-4.00% range; U.S. stock and bond markets are closed Thu Nov 26 for Thanksgiving and close early Fri
news.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis / CNBC

news.headline: FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86, handing Orlando its first NBA Cup loss, and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wed Nov 25 in NBA Cup play (Heat now 10-7); next: Heat at the New York Knicks Fri Nov 27, Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28

NFL Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 — Bears at Lions 1 PM ET, Eagles at Cowboys 4:30 PM ET and Chiefs at Bills 8:20 PM ET; no Florida team plays on Thanksgiving (Jacksonville remains the only active franchise never to play on the holiday) — ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
